turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, and I'd like to start with why my son found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of a class before anyone called me. Who decided that?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
You're welcome. Now answer the question: who entered the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before they did?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.

"Ninety-four percent." That's a piece of software's opinion, and I have the vendor's own guide in my bag saying it shouldn't be the sole basis for any action against a student. You still haven't told me whether Owen was heard before that zero went in, Hale.
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.

"Quite reliable." Fourteen of these tools were tested in 2023 and the researchers called them neither accurate nor reliable, and your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone doesn't establish anything. So is there anything else, Hale, or is a machine's guess the whole case?
So I had to give him a zero.

"Had to." So you decided first and asked questions later, in plain breach of 4.2, which says you contact me before any mark goes in. I want that zero withdrawn and an apology to Owen, or I'm in the principal's office before I leave this building.
I hope you understand my position.
Don't manage me, Hale. Your position is a software score and a zero entered without a phone call, and I'm writing that down. What else do you have?
